fallbackProjects.name: Aarohan – Flagship Musical Medical Fundraiser
fallbackProjects.shortDescription: Annual musical fundraiser supporting pediatric heart surgeries, thalassemia treatments, and critical care for underprivileged children.
fallbackProjects.fullDescription: Aarohan is Rotary Bangalore JP Nagar's hallmark charity concert uniting classical and contemporary artists to fund life-saving medical procedures for pediatric patients, including heart surgeries and ongoing thalassemia management in premier hospitals across Bengaluru.

fallbackProjects.name: Empowering Young Minds – Government School Upliftment
fallbackProjects.shortDescription: Providing government school students with digital classrooms, educational supplies, and infrastructure upgrades.
fallbackProjects.fullDescription: Under our Happy School initiative, Rotary Bangalore JP Nagar equips government and rural schools around Bengaluru with modern desks, smart TVs, science laboratories, school uniforms, and clean drinking water facilities.

fallbackProjects.name: Dialysis Center Support & Health Screening
fallbackProjects.shortDescription: State-of-the-art dialysis machines and subsidized renal care access at CDSIMER Hospital.
fallbackProjects.fullDescription: Rotary Bangalore JP Nagar has partnered with CDSIMER to inaugurate and maintain modern dialysis units, providing subsidized and free treatments to economically vulnerable patients suffering from chronic kidney conditions.
